result.title: GDD: A Remote Sensing Image Deepfake Detection and Manipulation Localization Dataset
result.summary: Verifying image authenticity is a critical need for a variety of applications and decision-making in the remote sensing (RS) domain, yet it is becoming more challenging as advancements in generative AI enable producing increasingly realistic synthetic overhead data. However, existing RS deepfake benchmarks prioritize sheer volume at the expense of visual realism and diversity, while also lacking rigorous out-of-distribution (OOD) testing protocols to evaluate real-world robustness. To address this, we introduce the Geospatial Deepfakes Dataset (GDD), a benchmark for RS deepfake detection and manipulation localization. Rather than relying on uncurated, redundant synthetic generation, GDD comprises images across diverse modern generative models and real image sources, alongside manipulations from diffusion inpainting, splicing, and copy-move operations. Crucially, GDD establishes an OOD evaluation protocol for deepfake detection comprising unseen real image sources and generative models. We benchmark five deepfake detectors and two localization models across intra- and cross-dataset regimes and reveal that detectors trained on high-volume, uncurated benchmarks overfit to dataset-specific artifacts, whereas training on GDD yields superior cross-dataset generalization despite its compact scale. This benchmarking also exposes critical failure modes in current state-of-the-art methods. Combined, GDD and its evaluation protocol establish a high-quality standard for developing and stress-testing detection and localization models in this safety-critical RS domain. The dataset is publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建遥感图像深度伪造检测与篡改定位数据集 GDD，覆盖多种生成模型与扩散修复、拼接、复制移动等篡改，并提供分布外评估协议，用于比较检测器与定位模型的跨数据集泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦伪造鉴别与篡改掩码定位的基准和 OOD 评测，不涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据选择、动态计算或答案如何使用视觉信息，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
